scatter_tensors_across_gpus: scatter tensors into approximately equal chunks and distribute them across given GPUs
scatter_kwargs_with_dict_support: scatter inputs and kwargs dictionary across target GPUs with matching tuple lengths
gather_tensors_from_gpus: gather tensors from different GPUs onto a specified target device
scatter_namedtuple_across_gpus: scatter namedtuples into chunks and distribute them across given GPUs
scatter_dict_across_gpus: scatter dictionaries into chunks and distribute key-value pairs across target GPUs
